name: Streaming Song
description:
Your party must include characters of 3 different Elemental Types to play this card. Convert 3 of your Elemental Dice to Omni Element. For the rest of this match, during each Roll Phase: Always roll 3 Omni Element dice. When you trigger an Elemental Reaction: DMG dealt is increased by 1. After you trigger an Elemental Reaction: Heal your most injured character for 1 HP.
(Only one "Arcane Legend" card can be played per match. This card will be in your starting hand.)

storytext:
"In those days, the moonlight would tell of their happiness to the nightingale and the rose.
And they were so frightened and abashed that they could sing no song in response.
Peace and ease reigned, and there was no division or misfortune in this worriless paradise...
If only these wonderful days, as lovely as a shimmering mirage, could last for eternity, and that they should never have to taste the bitterness of parting."
